title: Forgets to add GST
plain: The new total skips the tax step. order_total adds GST, but this new function only applies the discount -- so every invoice is 18% short. The GST rule lives in pricing.py.
diff:
--- a/orders.py
+++ b/orders.py
@@ -17,6 +17,14 @@
     return round(add_gst(after_discount), 2)
 
 
+def quick_total(customer_id, base_amount):
+    """Total payable for a customer."""
+    customer = find_customer(customer_id)
+    if customer is None:
+        return 0
+    return apply_discount(base_amount, customer["tier"])
+
+
